description: This file defines data structures and functions for parsing and retrieving system and CPU statistics from the Linux /proc filesystem, including CPU time breakdowns, softirq stats, and overall system stats.

methods.name: parseCPUStat
methods.description: Parses a line of CPU statistics from /proc/stat and returns a CPUStat object and CPU ID.

methods.name: parseSoftIRQStat
methods.description: Parses a line of softirq statistics from /proc/stat and returns a SoftIRQStat object and total count.

methods.name: NewStat
methods.description: Retrieves current system statistics by reading /proc/stat.

methods.name: Stat
methods.description: Main data structure holding various system and CPU statistics.
